note: sim-reset-alarms-correct-1126 (2026-11-26, docs/357, WRITTEN, NOT RUN): correctness of simresetalarms (EA bug fix, docs/352: a Sim reset on the world lot keeps the Sim's repeating NeverPersisted alarms, as vanilla keeps them on every other lot) and its probe simresetalarmprobe. Job 1 probe arm: BP 10 min natural play, probe on, fix off: answers docs/352 Q1 (how often a Sim reset asks the global manager, which callbacks are lost); nothing may be kept or removed (simresetalarms_kept 0, _listdrops 0). Job 2 fix arm: same play, fix (mode 1) + probe on: 0 script errors, no error counted, no alarm removed by the (empty) drop list. Job 3: repro sim-reset-alarms (off arm then fix arm in one load, two townies): the off arm's world-lot reset loses both vampire alarms (the bug; a hollow repro fails the job), the fix arm keeps them; a normal-lot reset keeps them in both arms. Switch read-back: fixesOn (profile-world prints fixes on: ... (verified)), the mode in the probe head line (mode=0 / mode=1), counters that move only with a switch on. Job 4: repro service-leave-reset with its live arms (docs/357 §4): the serviceleave live-timeout rule on a real repairman, street arm and lot arm. ON condition for simresetalarms: this queue passes AND the 30 repeating NeverPersisted sites are read (docs/352 Q2, docs/357 §3). Household: mode 1 applies to every Sim by design (EA bug fix whose result equals vanilla on a normal lot; CLAUDE.md "EA bug fixes stay", docs/357 §3). Household untouched here means: no Sim, household included, loses an alarm vanilla keeps (logForbid on "dropped (list)", simresetalarms_listdrops 0), and the probe arm changes nothing (no "kept (fix)" line with the fix off); the repro touches townies only (agent DtScope). Bin state apex (Apex latest + RTX Remix bridge). Est 60 min. No timing queue: an EA bug fix on a rare path (a reset), no gain claimed. The chain copies the two packages named here from game-copy into build/ as the m1126 chains do.
